app.notes: Mine it or buy it: compare with providers — what renting each rig costs at Spheron right now (dedicated servers only), against what it earns, cheapest first, with a way to use that price in the calculator. Every rig shows how many machines on the network run it right now, every setup GNOT can set up is in the calculator (B200 and A100 too), and Host Setup's first page has a What it earns button for the setup you pick. Host Setup now says to rent a dedicated server, never spot: a spot server can be taken back mid-epoch and then that epoch pays nothing. Every loading screen shows a moving chain of blocks.
